keyPoints.en: I / you / we / they + verb: I play, they play.
keyPoints.hi: I / you / we / they + क्रिया: I play, they play।

keyPoints.en: he / she / it + verb + s/es: he plays, she watches.
keyPoints.hi: he / she / it + क्रिया + s/es: he plays, she watches।

keyPoints.en: Add -es after s, sh, ch, x, o: go → goes, wash → washes.
keyPoints.hi: s, sh, ch, x, o के बाद -es: go → goes, wash → washes।

problem.en: Fill in with the right form of "eat": "Ravi __ an apple every day."
problem.hi: "eat" का सही रूप भरो: "Ravi __ an apple every day."

problem.en: Fill in with "go": "My sister __ to dance class."
problem.hi: "go" से भरो: "My sister __ to dance class."

steps.en: One person (she); "go" ends in o → add -es.

question.en: Fill in with "play": "They __ cricket in the evening."
question.hi: "play" से भरो: "They __ cricket in the evening."

question.en: Find the verb: "Birds fly in the sky."
question.hi: क्रिया ढूँढो: "Birds fly in the sky."

intro.en: A verb is an action word. The simple present tense tells what happens every day or always: "I walk to school." With he, she, it or one person we add -s or -es: "She walks to school."
intro.hi: क्रिया (verb) काम वाला शब्द है। Simple present tense रोज़ होने वाली या हमेशा की बात बताता है: "I walk to school." He, she, it या एक व्यक्ति के साथ -s या -es लगाते हैं: "She walks to school."
